question: 查询所有有效订单的总销售金额。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录，求 paid_amount 字段的总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 统计有效订单中不同支付方式的订单数量。
intended_meaning: 按 payment_method 分组，统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单数量。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY payment_method;

question: 列出所有在售商品的品牌与所属类目。
intended_meaning: 从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的记录，返回 brand 和 category 两列。
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT brand, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;

question: 找出有效订单中销量最高的前5个商品名称及对应销售数量。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单，按 product_name 汇总 quantity 总和，取前5名。
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计各城市的有效订单销售金额，并按金额从高到低排序。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders 和 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单，按 users.city 分组汇总 paid_amount，降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;

question: 计算手机数码类目的产品退款率（批准退款金额 / 对应类目销售金额）。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，限定类目为'手机数码'且订单有效、退款状态为'approved'，计算 approved refund_amount 总和除以对应类目有效订单 item_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';

question: 查询2026年8月各日的有效订单销售金额趋势（日期、金额）。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 order_date 在 2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31 的记录，按 order_date 分组汇总 paid_amount，并按日期升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_date, SUM(paid_amount) AS daily_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date <= '2026-08-31' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

question: 统计有效订单中男性与女性用户的付费用户数。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders 和 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单，按 users.gender 分组统计去重 user_id 数量。
reference_sql: SELECT u.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.gender;

question: 列出七天无理由退款的订单号与退款金额。
intended_meaning: 从 refunds 表中筛选 refund_reason = '七天无理由' 且 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，返回 order_no（需关联 orders）和 refund_amount。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_no, r.refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_reason = '七天无理由' AND r.refund_status = 'approved';

question: 统计南京市用户产生的有效订单总销售金额。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders 和 users 表，筛选 users.city = '南京市' 且 orders.order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录，求 paid_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.city = '南京市' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');
